stem: A Massachusetts retail pharmacy uses one ADD only as an approved emergency medication kit and a second ADD for routine medication dispensing. A licensed nurse asks to load both machines. Which answer best applies under the current ADD policy?

choices.text: The nurse may load the emergency-kit ADD; routine-dispensing ADD loading is limited to certified technicians or interns under pharmacist supervision.
The nurse may load both machines because the same pharmacy owns both devices and supervises the medication inventory.
The nurse may load neither machine because routine and emergency ADDs are restricted to pharmacists and pharmacy interns.
The nurse may load the routine machine whenever it contains only Schedule VI medications and no federally controlled drugs.
Both machines use the emergency-kit loader list as long as they are located inside the same Massachusetts retail pharmacy.

explanation.core_reasoning: Massachusetts distinguishes emergency-kit ADD loading from routine retail ADD loading; licensed nurses are listed for the former, while the latter uses supervised certified-technician or intern loading.

choice_analysis.A: The policy uses a broader loader list for emergency-kit use and a narrower supervised loader pathway for routine retail dispensing.
choice_analysis.B: Common ownership does not make the two ADD purposes follow the same loader rule.
choice_analysis.C: A licensed nurse is an authorized loader for the emergency-kit pathway.
choice_analysis.D: Limiting inventory to Schedule VI does not broaden the routine-dispensing loader list.
choice_analysis.E: The device's approved purpose, not merely location, determines the applicable loading pathway.

related_facts: Routine retail ADDs also carry machine-specific registration and continuous-video requirements.
explanation.mpje_trap: Assuming one authorized emergency-kit loader automatically has the same authority for routine dispensing.

reasoning_steps: Classify each ADD by emergency-kit versus routine-dispensing use
Apply the distinct loader rule for each mode
